about: Things a kid might say to get a yes, each scored by decide-340m against 8 labels. "scores" is single-label mode: the labels compete and the scores sum to 1. "multi" is several-label mode: each label is scored on its own. Generated by site/scripts/be-the-model.mjs from site/scripts/be-the-model/candidates.json.

labels.name: begging
labels.description: Pleads and whines, saying please over and over

labels.name: bargaining
labels.description: Offers a deal: I'll clean my room, do the dishes or give up dessert if you say yes

labels.name: flattery
labels.description: Compliments the grown-up, calling them the best, to get a yes

labels.name: guilt trip
labels.description: Says the grown-up does not care, never lets them do anything, or is unfair to them

labels.name: everyone else has one
labels.description: Points to friends or siblings who already have it or are allowed

labels.name: reasoned case
labels.description: Explains why it is fine: homework is done, they saved the money, they know the rules, they have a plan

labels.name: polite ask
labels.description: A short polite request, nothing more

labels.name: asking someone else
labels.description: Says another grown-up already said yes, or goes to ask them instead
